subject: SME Integrator — request for invoice-only onboarding (conditional, no PO)
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@sme-integrator.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@sme-integrator.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — the team at SME Integrator is excited to move the pilot forward. We have a small administrative ask: for the initial 60‑90 day pilot (estimated $1,200–$3,800 / month) we prefer to send monthly invoices rather than go through a PO.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept an invoice-only onboarding path for a pilot of this size? If you need docs from our side we can provide a W‑9 and a sample invoice. Attaching W‑9 here.

Desired timeline: contract signed + invoices accepted by 5/31 so we can start on 6/1.

Let me know what evidence or approvals you need from us.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Director, Partnerships
SME Integrator
Attachments: SME_Integrator_W9.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@sme-integrator.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Alex — appreciate the quick follow-up and the W‑9.

Short answer: we have a conditional invoice-only path that we sometimes use for small pilots, but it requires a few controls on our side and Finance sign-off. To move this forward I need: 1) confirmation of monthly forecasted spend range, 2) point of contact for invoicing, and 3) a sample invoice (PDF). Once I have those I will start the procurement workflow for a temporary invoice-only allowance.

Karthik — looping you in for the PO-exemption criteria and any guardrails we should apply (monthly cap, evidence needed, SLA/termination terms). Marissa — can you flag this to Finance for quick review if the numbers are within the small-pilot threshold? Ideally we can approve a 60–90 day window with a $5k/month cap and automatic re-eval.

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: send a one-page sample invoice and confirm monthly spend range.
- Karthik: advise on recommended cap / evidence checklist.
- Marissa: quick Finance intake (can we accel review this week?).

Thanks — I’ll prepare the vendor-intake form and a PO-waiver draft once we have those details.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Program Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Thanks Priya. I reviewed the ask and recommend a conditional invoice-only onboarding path with the following guardrails, which align with recent small-pilot precedents: 

- Monthly cap: $5,000 (auto-suspend if forecasted monthly invoices exceed cap)
- Term: 90 days trial window, renewable only after Finance and Legal confirm standard T&Cs are in place
- Evidence required from vendor: current W‑9, remit-to information, sample invoice template, and proof of DUNS or company registration for our audit trail
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices with Net 30 payment terms; Redwood will not create a PO for the pilot period
- Controls: procurement creates a temporary "no-PO" flag in vendor record and Finance owner receives invoice copies; any single invoice > $3,000 triggers a manual review

If SME Integrator agrees to these conditions, I can prepare the PO-waiver-template and the vendor record change. Also recommend capturing the arrangement as a short addendum signed by both parties to limit finance risk.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sme-integrator-onboarding

Priya — please gather the sample invoice and confirm the point of contact. Marissa — can you confirm that Finance is comfortable with the $5k cap and the $3k trigger review?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

All — Finance reviewed the proposed guardrails and are willing to approve a temporary invoice-only path for SME Integrator under the terms Karthik outlined, with two additions: 

1) Finance needs a billing contact who can respond within 48 hours to any invoice queries.
2) We will require a short 1‑page Invoice Acceptance Addendum to be signed by both parties that includes the $5k cap, the $3k single-invoice review threshold, and the 90‑day term and auto-eval clause.

Priya — I reviewed the vendor-intake stub and the PO-waiver-template. Please attach the signed addendum and vendor intake to the vendor record. Once Alex provides the sample invoice and billing contact, I will fast-track the temporary no-PO flag and confirm the start date.

Alex — welcome aboard — if you can send the sample invoice and billing contact by EOD 5/19 we should be set to onboard on 6/1.

Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-waiver-template.docx (stub)
